title: Sync memories via encrypted blob (RN+iOS)
description:
Memories now ride on the encrypted SyncPayload, versioned per-key with LWW + tombstones. Cross-platform between iOS native and React Native. Backwards compatible (memories field is optional). Migration moves legacy AsyncStorage / UserDefaults entries into the new layout once.

Files touched:
- packages/mobile-app: types.ts, mergeUtils.ts, memoriesSlice.ts (new), store.ts, syncMiddleware.ts, StorageService.ts, SyncService.ts, mergeMemories.test.ts (new)
- packages/ios-app: SyncService.swift (SyncableMemory + mergeMemories), StorageService.swift (versioned layout + migration), MemoryService.swift (schedulePush wiring), AppState.swift

iOS build verified, RN merge tests (6/6) verified.
close_reason: Implemented and verified: iOS BUILD SUCCEEDED, RN mergeMemories 6/6 tests pass

title: iOS: short-term memory + auto-dream loop
description: iOS app lacks MemoryLoopService equivalent. Short-term memory can grow unbounded. Add: PersonalDataService, /api/chat/memory-update wiring, MemoryLoopService (5min/2KB threshold), DreamingView overlay, wire compress to persist updated short-term memory.

title: iOS: Onboarding Flow
description: First-launch experience: language input modal, initial chat creation, onboarding flag. Guides new users through initial setup before they can start using the app.
close_reason: Onboarding flow implemented: 3-page SwiftUI TabView with welcome, language selection, and completion screens

title: iOS: Offline Support & Data Sync
description: Persistent local storage for offline use. Message sync with backend server. Tombstone deletion with sync markers. Draft text preservation for unfinished messages.

title: iOS: Memory & Context System
description: Track conversation memories/context. Memory compression for long conversations. Memory tagging for organization. Memory retrieval requests from AI. Long-term memory storage across sessions.

title: iOS: Message Controls
description: Edit previously sent messages. Delete messages (soft delete for sync). Retry failed message submissions. Regenerate AI response after edits. Cancel in-progress AI responses mid-generation. Long-press to copy message text to clipboard.

title: iOS: Quick-Start Experiences
description: 5-minute check-in (quick wellness conversation starter). 15-minute check-in (extended starter). Language/experience selection before starting. Inspirational quotes display in empty chat state.

title: iOS: Health Data Integration
description: Connect to HealthKit. Track weekly/monthly/6-week exercise statistics. Monitor sleep data (bed time, wake time, time in bed). Track mental health/mood valence (daily/weekly/monthly). Automatically include summarized health data in AI context.

title: iOS: Authentication & Account
description: Account creation with email/password. Login/logout. Password reset (forgot password). Change password. View account balance/credits. Account-dependent features (model access, chat sharing).
close_reason: Authentication implemented: sign in, sign up, forgot password, change password, token refresh, sign out, account view with balance/subscription display

title: iOS: Settings & Personalization
description: Model selection (multiple AI models). Communication style (Default, Less Bloat, Adapt to Conversant, Informal). Language configuration. Persona configuration (age, occupation, goals, preferences - 1000 char limit). Toggle features: conversational style, keep conversation going, think outside the box, experimental new model questions, library integration. System prompt generator. Custom assistant name. Custom system prompt editing.
close_reason: Settings view implemented: model selection, communication style, language, assistant name, behavior toggles, persona (1000 char limit), custom system prompt

title: iOS: Conversation Sharing
description: Share conversations publicly or privately. Set visibility (PRIVATE/PUBLIC). Add title and description. Generate shareable URLs. Copy share URL to clipboard. View shared conversation count.

title: iOS: Shared Conversations Browser
description: Browse publicly shared conversations from the community. View metadata (title, description, view count, creation date). Infinite scroll, pull-to-refresh. Access via deep linking (universal links and custom URL scheme).

title: iOS: Artifacts & Project Files
description: Create and manage artifacts (files/documents) within projects. Hierarchical folder structure. Edit artifact content. Delete with confirmation. Move between folders. View metadata (type, name, MIME type).

title: iOS: Project Management
description: Create and organize projects. View all projects with metadata (creation date, chat count). Edit project name/description. Delete projects. Filter chats by project. Two-tab view: Chats tab and Artifacts tab. Clear project filter to see all chats.

title: iOS: Chat/Conversation System
description: Core chat functionality: create/view/manage conversations with AI assistant. Send/receive messages, edit messages, delete messages (tombstone sync), view chat history, sort by project, auto-suggest answers, assign chats to projects. Includes request-type conversations as a separate chat type.
close_reason: Core chat system implemented: create/select/delete chats, send messages with SSE streaming, edit/delete/regenerate messages, title generation, memory loop handling, draft persistence

title: iOS Native App - Feature Implementation Epic
description:
Implement a native iOS app (Swift/SwiftUI) alongside the existing React Native app. This epic tracks all features that need to be implemented natively.

IMPORTANT: The existing React Native app serves as a REFERENCE FOR FEATURES AND UX ONLY. Do NOT use it as a code reference — the codebase quality is poor. Design the iOS app with clean, idiomatic Swift/SwiftUI architecture from scratch. Look at the RN app to understand what the feature does and how it looks, then implement it properly.

title: iOS: Prompt Suggestions
description: Collapsible UI panel showing backend-provided prompt suggestions. Users tap a suggestion to insert it into their message input. Fetched from the server, displayed contextually in the chat view.

title: iOS: Library/PDF Integration
description: Toggle to enable PDF librarian context in conversations. AI can query a personal library/knowledge base. Search tool schema passed to chat API when enabled.

title: iOS: Calendar Integration
description: Request calendar access permissions. Fetch past week events, upcoming week events, and upcoming events. 1-hour caching. Provide calendar context to AI conversations. Separate from HealthKit integration.

title: iOS: Deep Linking
description: Open shared conversations via universal links and custom URL scheme. Handle app scheme and web URLs for shared content.

title: iOS: Passcode Protection
description: Set 4-digit passcode to lock the app. Edit/update passcode. Lock screen when app is accessed without valid passcode.

title: iOS: Support/Donation Page
description: Multiple donation options. Support via cryptocurrency or external links. Copy donation addresses to clipboard.
close_reason: Donate view implemented: displays donation options from global config with copy-to-clipboard and external links
